Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: N/A (None) • Install: Hospital

Don’t worry too much about how it works, just be happy it lets you chrome up more without going nuts.

Iconic Neuralware. While installed, the Max Humanity Reduction from all other installed Cyberware is reduced by 1, or by 2 for Borgware. Only one Chrome Compressor may be installed at a time.

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Maximum Humanity isn't tracked per piece by the sheet, so work the reduction out by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
